replies.author: de0u
replies.text:
Onlyfun Failed chain verification was fixed by setting current date and time. But next time battery dies it happens again cause time rolls back to the last update.

When a Pixel is running an operating system, the OS keeps time. When the device is "off", there is a clock on the motherboard that keeps time, but not as accurately. Some individual devices have motherboard clocks that are more accurate than others.

It sounds as if one of your devices may have a less-accurate motherboard clock. When the OS boots, if the motherboard clock has an unreasonable value, it may set the clock to the build date of the OS.

But meanwhile it is not normal for a device's battery to repeatedly run all the way flat. This can result in data corruption which results in the device being unbootable, which will require wiping the device. If one device is routinely running the battery flat, it is probably important to figure out why this is happening, to correct it. Perhaps that device's battery is worn out?
